_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Airworthiness Directives/Service Bulletins/Advisory Data
summary: This DID provides information to support the operation and maintenance of FAA or equivalent certified commercial aircraft, including product improvements, service information, and flight safety data.
description_purpose: This data provides information to support the operation and maintenance of FAA or equivalent certified commercial type aircraft acquired/modified by the Government. Included in the data are product improvements, service information/letters and safety of flight information which affect the FAA or equivalent certification of the aircraft.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the contract.
7.2 Data ranges in applicability from mandatory FAA airworthiness directives to informational advisory data. Data is based largely on experience of commercial/military users of similar type FAA or equivalent certified aircraft.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: This data shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The types of data are prepared in accordance with prevailing commercial and FAA practices. The following data is applicable to aircraft and/or associated equipment.

children.title: Advisory Data includes the following information:
Operation manuals and bulletins/changes (to include FAA approved Flight Manual)
FAA Notice of Proposed Rule Making
